items.title: Dali-2 controls support £18.8m Innovation Centre in Suffolk
items.summary: A DALI-2 control system has been installed at a new £18.8m Suffolk skills centre, intended to support energy management and simplify maintenance across the three-storey building as part of its sustainability strategy.

items.title: Product Monday: iGuzzini’s Laser Evo Modular Downlights
items.summary: iGuzzini has launched Laser Evo, a modular recessed downlight platform offering over a million configuration options with a focus on optical control and visual comfort, plus connected-control compatibility for retail, hospitality and residential use.
